Home.title: Housing Partnership Platform
Home.taglineSummary: The Housing Partnership Platform is an AI-enabled platform that matches partners, shares knowledge, and drives innovative housing and mixed-use projects, to help deliver equitable, sustainable, and affordable housing solutions across Canada.
Home.shortDescription: The Housing Partnership Platform is a web-based platform designed to unlock collaborative potential across public, private, and non-profit sectors and foster partnerships between developers, non-profits, municipalities, lenders and other housing stakeholders. Powered by AI-enabled matchmaking and knowledge-sharing tools, the platform empowers stakeholders to co-create resilient, equitable, and sustainable developments that address Canada's complex affordable housing crisis.
Home.elevatorPitch: The Housing Partnership Platform, developed at the Centre for Social Services Engineering (University of Toronto), is a web platform designed to connect developers, municipalities, non-profits, lenders, and government agencies to co-create innovative mixed-use projects. By combining smart matchmaking, knowledge-sharing tools and access to funding support, the platform aims to help foster diverse partnerships that prioritize affordable housing, Indigenous-led initiatives, and sustainability. Beyond connecting stakeholders, it equips them with training, mentorship, and best practices to ensure projects are equitable, resilient, and financially viable, unlocking collaborative solutions to Canada’s housing crisis.

About.title: About the Housing Partnership Platform
About.body: The Housing Partnership Platform is a web-based hub created by the University of Toronto's Centre for Social Services Engineering. Designed to help tackle Canada's complex housing challenges, it makes available knowledge-sharing resources and uses AI-powered matchmaking to help connect developers, non-profits, municipalities, lenders, and government agencies. By fostering diverse partnerships, including Indigenous-led initiatives, the platform empowers stakeholders to co-create innovative mixed-use projects that deliver sustainable, equitable and affordable housing.
